correctness.rationale: Superpose vertex clocks of rates p,p,q to Poisson total R=2p+q. At each event the signed edge increment has conditional expectation (q/R) tanh(alpha artanh X_n), where X_n=(W1-W2)/(S0+n). Its martingale innovation is bounded and has conditional variance 1-(q/R)^2 F_alpha(X_n)^2. For alpha<1, |F_alpha(x)|<=|x| yields X_n->0, hence drift linearization a-1 with a=alpha q/R and limiting innovation variance one. Renlund’s stochastic approximation theorems supply Gaussian, log-critical, and a.s. polynomial regimes at contraction 1-a above/equal/below 1/2; Poisson time-change gives normalized imbalance limits and independent total-mass Gaussian noise, producing joint covariance R/4[[1+v,1-v],[1-v,1+v]] with v=1/(1-2a) and correlation -a/(1-a). At a>=1/2 count noise is negligible. Alpha_c=(2p+q)/(2q)<1 iff q>2p.
